text:
josh: Kicking off micro-ramp for `splitroute_switch` -> target model v3.0 in the 02:00 UTC change window. plan: 1% -> 5% -> 15% -> 30% with 7m soak between steps. rollout-bot will manage increments.
priya: Copy. Are we pinning any user cohorts to avoid mixed-weight routing?
josh: Yes — pin region europe-west cohorts 2 and 3 to v3.0 for 45m. that keeps steady traffic for regression checks. others follow ramp percentages.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduling feature flag update `splitroute_switch` to 1% (model v3.0). run run_9f1c. safety-mode: manual-ack between steps. ETA: starting now.
sam: Quick checklist: metrics dashboards up, traces sampling 10%, cost watch enabled. runbook: /runbooks/featureflag-ramp.
priya: I set alert thresholds: p95 + 40ms, 5xx > 0.3% in 3m window. Alerts go to #incidents and page @oncall.
josh: Rollback plan: immediate set flag 0% + remove pins. Prepared command: ```
deploy-bot toggle --flag splitroute_switch --value 0 --reason "rollback - threshold breach" --run run_9f1c
```
priya: Also have a quick-unpin if we see session-affinity issues: ```
rollout-bot unpin --cohorts "eu-2,eu-3" --run run_9f1c
```
rollout-bot: rollout-bot: applied step 1 -> 1%. pinned cohorts [eu-2, eu-3]. next check scheduled in 7m.
sam: Step1 metrics: p95 +1ms, error rate unchanged, QPS down 0.5%. looks stable so far.
priya: 👍 continue to 5% after soak. keep safety-mode so manual ack required.
josh: Note — we purposely reduced step sizes because v3.0 changes tokenization path; conservative ramp to limit cache pressure.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: ramp to 5% requested, awaiting manual ack.
priya: Acked. proceed.
rollout-bot: rollout-bot: completed step 2 -> 5%. scheduled soak check at 1765560598.
sam: Watching traces: a small uptick in embeddings latency (~8ms), but within expected. no rollback.
josh: I'll update the release notes: https://redwood/internal/releases/rel-3.0-splitroute (add run_9f1c, pins, metrics anchors). If anything hits thresholds, execute rollback command and notify @oncall.
priya: After 30m of stable 30% target we'll decide pin/unpin policy. if stable, we plan to gradually remove pins and expand to full rollout next week.
ops-bot: ops-bot: safety-mode confirmed for run run_9f1c. paging policy active.
josh: thanks team. keeping channel open for 1hr monitoring. :eyes:
